answer: One concrete mechanism: weight rewards by the number of distinct jurisdictions that observed the work. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The horizon of work and the anchor of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a oasis to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
